塞翁失马.literal: The old man of the frontier lost his horse
塞翁失马.meaning: A blessing in disguise; setbacks may turn into good fortune

画蛇添足.literal: Draw a snake and add feet to it
画蛇添足.meaning: Ruin the effect by adding something superfluous

半途而废.meaning: Give up halfway without completing the task

胸有成竹.literal: Have a bamboo plant already formed in one's chest
胸有成竹.meaning: Having a well-thought-out plan and confidence in success beforehand

卧薪尝胆.literal: Sleep on brushwood and taste gall
卧薪尝胆.meaning: Enduring bitter hardships patiently to achieve long-term goals

名落孙山.literal: Name falls behind Sun Shan (who was last on the imperial pass list)
名落孙山.meaning: Fail to pass a competitive examination

一目了然.literal: Understand clearly at a single glance

循序渐进.literal: Follow the sequence and advance gradually
循序渐进.meaning: Make steady, systematic progress step by step

博大精深.literal: Broad and vast, refined and profound

水到渠成.literal: When water flows, a canal is formed
水到渠成.meaning: Conditions are ripe and success comes naturally
